newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan says U.S. productivity rises understated.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan says U.S. productivity rises understated.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on Wednesday repeated his assertion that government statistics were understating U.S. productivity.
Speaking to the National Association of Business Economists, the Fed Chairman emphasized particular problems in the service sector.

He said that growth in business profit margins that would be inconsistent with the extent of productivity gains suggested in official statistics point to the conclusion that productivity is understated.
"Productivity numbers have to be going up faster than the published data show," he said.
